[[File:OperationalTaskAvailable.png|right|thumb|Therapist has a quest available.]]\n\n''For the story quests, see [[Story chapters|story chapters]].''\n\n'''{{PAGENAME}}''', both player-given and dynamically generated, are intended to be a large part of ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.\n\nSome require you to pick stuff up for certain [[Trading#Traders|traders]], while others require you to kill other operators or mark vehicles and specific places.\nQuests are the fastest way of gaining [[EXP]]. Completing one will often reward you with experience points, [[Trading#Traders|trader]] reputation, money, valuable loot, rare [[containers]], and unlock the purchase of new items.\n\nWhen a trader has a quest available, they will have a green tick on their icon.\n\n==Quest items==\nSome items only spawn if the respective quest is active. These items fall in the [[:Category:Quest Items|quest items category]] and cannot be used, sold or discarded.\n* Quest items do not spawn in the practice game mode.\n* When picked up, quest items are transferred to the player’s quest item inventory. If the player fails to extract with a quest item, they will lose it.<br />To prevent losing quest items, it is strongly recommended to turn them in before starting another raid or transferring them to the quest item special stash in the \»Quest items\» tab of the \»Tasks\» tab if you do not want to continue the quest in the next raid (e.g. during [[Delivery From the Past]]).\n* While quest items are required to be [[Found in raid|found in raid]] as there is no other way to obtain them, the player does '''not''' have to avoid the Run Through status.\n\n==Image [[EXP]]\n* Unlocks [[Icebreaker]] in the location selection\n|-\n|}</table-progress-tracking>\n</div></div>\n\n==Operational Tasks==\nOperational tasks are random daily and weekly quests that are given to the player by various [[traders]]. They are typically simple quests, such as find and handover an item, or kill [[Scavs]] at a certain [[Map of Tarkov|location]]. The rewards for these quests are largely randomized and can give a variety of items and [[EXP]]. If you do not want the task you have been given, you can pay the trader some [[roubles]] and take a reputation penalty for a new random task. Players who have bought the \»Edge of Darkness\» edition of the game may replace 2 daily quests per day without penalty or fee.\n\n===Daily===\nDaily operational tasks become available to players at level 5.\n\n====Rewards====\n''The following is approximate data based on observation. Actual rewards vary over time for individual players based on their history of completing operational tasks.''\n{| class=\»wikitable\»\n!Character level\n!Reward\n|-\n!5 — 45\n|\n* 3,782 — 10,532 [[EXP]]\n* Up to 364,000 [[Roubles]] or, if from [[Peacekeeper]], up to 2,815 [[Euros]]\n* Up to 5 items\n|-\n!46+\n|\n* 20,576 — 75,202 [[EXP]]\n* Up to 626,000 [[Roubles]] or, if from [[Peacekeeper]], up to 6,400 [[Euros]]\n* Up to 8 items till level 70, no more items at level 71+\n|}\nOperational tasks also provide +0.01 reputation with the respective trader.\n\n====List of Quests====\n{| class=\»wikitable\»\n! Quest Name\n! Objectives\n|-\n! Find And Transfer\n|\n* Find and Handover some number of randomly selected [[Loot|items]]\n|-\n! Elimination\n|\n* Kill 4-25 Scavs, can have a modifier (or combination):\n** From a distance of more than 20-50 meters\n** Killing via damage to a specific body part\n** Use specified weapon/ weapon category\n|-\n! Elimination\n|\n* Kill 2-15 PMCs, can have a modifier (or combination):\n** From a distance of more than 20-100 meters\n** Killing via damage to a specific body part\n** Use specified weapon/ weapon category\n** On a specific map \n|-\n! Elimination\n|\n* Kill a certain [[Boss]]:\n** At any distance\n** From a distance of more than 20-80 meters\n** Use specified weapon/ weapon category\n|-\n! Exit the location\n|\n* Survive and Extract from a random [[Map_of_Tarkov|location]] 1-12 times<br />\n|-\n! Exit the location\n|\n* Survive and Extract from a particular extract from a random [[Map_of_Tarkov|location]]<br />\n\nRun Throughs do not count<sup>1</sup>\n|-\n|}\n<sup>1</sup>A Run Through is when you extract meeting both of the following conditions:\n* Earned less than 200 exp from looting and killing\n* Player has been in the raid for less than 7 minutes.\n\n===Weekly===\nWeekly operational tasks are also available to players at level 15.
